meaning.en: To make promises one cannot or will not keep.

examples.zh: 竞选时他们开了很多空头支票。
examples.en: During the campaign they made many empty promises.

examples.zh: 没有把握的事别乱开空头支票。
examples.en: Don't hand out empty promises about things you can't guarantee.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; 空头支票 is a bounced cheque. Often with 别 or 只会.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，“空头支票”指无法兑现的支票。常说“别开空头支票”“只会开空头支票”。

meaning.en: To be in decline, getting worse over time.
meaning.zh: 比喻事物衰落、走向衰败。

examples.zh: 这家老企业这几年一直走下坡路。
examples.en: This old firm has been going downhill for years.

examples.zh: 他的身体已经开始走下坡路了。
examples.en: His health has started to decline.

usage.en: Verb-object, casual; the opposite is 走上坡路.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，口语，与“走上坡路”相对。
